items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go Monday vs Bears; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Full clearance after prior exit/stinger concerns.
items.implication: Full workloads expected MNF; reverse any backup buzz.
items.opportunity: Barkley lead RB snaps/carries/RZ; Smith primary WR targets.

items.text: Bears officially ruled out QB Caleb Williams for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent full practice, questionable but returning.
items.implication: Bagent starts; CHI pass game downgrade, run lean possible.
items.opportunity: Bagent streamer; CHI skill players volume shift if conservative.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday vs DEN (hip/groin); not expected to play per reports, but projected back Week 4 barring setback.
items.why: DNP all week; McVay: more unlikely than likely; Adams thrived in absence last week.
items.implication: Adams elevated to primary WR1 role/target share.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams routes/targets spike; secondary WRs/TEs residual volume.

items.text: Texans ruled WR Nico Collins OUT Sunday at IND due to hamstring; missed practice all week, second straight absence.
items.implication: Schultz target share jumps (30%+ routes prior); Hutchinson/Boutte residual.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz TE1 volume; other HOU WRs flex upside.

items.text: Steelers ruled RB Rico Dowdle OUT Sunday vs CIN (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says he will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury; Chinyoung: Warren leads, breathers as needed.
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren snaps/carries/targets expand significantly; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Brock Bowers QUESTIONABLE (knee); ETR/Levitan projecting IN for Sunday.
items.why: Listed Q; Levitan sims have him in.
items.implication: TE1 if active; monitor for change.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate vs Jets home.
items.why: Ridiculous early workload + matchup; only CMC prior similar base.

items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Jayden Daniels Sunday vs SEA; not IR, week-to-week after specialists, aiming return soon with brace; Mariota starts.
items.why: Elbow dislocation imaging/specialists consensus; no IR.
items.implication: Mariota start; Daniels ROS value holds better than feared.
items.opportunity: WAS pass catchers floor down short-term; Daniels stash.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (Q shoulder) IN; with Dowdle out, expects lead role + zillion checkdowns as vertical game failing for Rodgers. Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Coach comments + usage data; vertical inefficiency.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; high floor via receptions.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + pass-game work; third-down/two-minute likely.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week w/ Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yds to TEs.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.opportunity: High carry/RZ share vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even w/ Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but Berry flags low share.
